# Sparkish

> Sparkish makes playful apps for everyday habits: AquaTick, a cat-themed hydration tracker; and KINETTO, a running app where real runs grow an anonymous Crew.

Use the localized landing page that matches the user's language. The product descriptions below reflect the public pages and should be preferred over legacy routes or asset mirrors.

Important product facts:
- AquaTick logs water from Home quick add actions and Apple Watch. Widgets, Live Activity, and Dynamic Island show progress but do not record intake.
- AquaTick is a hydration habit tracker, not a medical device or a source of medical advice.
- KINETTO is coming soon on iOS. Android is planned for later; its public pages do not collect email or link to an app store.
- AquaTick can be used without an account.

- [AquaTick language selection](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/aquatick/): Routes visitors to Korean, English, or Japanese content.

- [AquaTick English landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/aquatick/en/): English product overview, features, screenshots, privacy details, Pro pricing, and App Store links.
- [AquaTick Japanese landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/aquatick/ja/): Japanese product overview, features, screenshots, privacy details, Pro pricing, and App Store links.
- [AquaTick on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/aquatick/id6762686013): Official App Store listing for downloading AquaTick.
- [AquaTick support](https://github.com/sparkish-xyz/AquaTick-Support/wiki/Support-en-US): Support information and contact options.
- [AquaTick privacy policy](https://github.com/sparkish-xyz/AquaTick-Support/wiki/Privacy-Policy): AquaTick's privacy policy.
